saw_lines: Parents buying kids’ winter gear ask about fit and warmth, then check delivery before paying, and reorder as children outgrow it.
So a parent who cannot see delivery in the ad leaves before clicking, and the sale is lost in the first line.
Your 11 of 24 copy ads open on the same ski collection line, so test three new openers built on the Neve jacket, Lumi pants and Quest suit against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Nov 2026
points: 11 of your 24 copy ads open on the same ski collection line, so a parent who skips it sees little else. Test three new openers built on the Neve jacket, Lumi pants and Quest suit, one per ad.

Your site explains shipping, including free shipping above 250€, yet 0 of 29 ads mention shipping or delivery. A first time parent leaves without the answer, so open three new ads with the 250€ free shipping line.

Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 29 ads show it. A parent who cannot picture the parcel at the door hesitates before paying. Shoot one short video of the parcel arriving and open with that scene.
One exact copy runs in 11 of your 24 copy ads, so a parent who sees two of them gets the same pitch twice. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each ad.

ads_1: Winter creative that opens on shipping, then tests two new ski angles
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
